python3 -c "
import subprocess

test_cases = [
    ([], '10\n20\n'),
    ([], '-50000\n50000\n'),
    (['good'], '46339\n'),
    (['good'], '46340\n'),
    (['good'], '-46339\n'),
    (['good'], '-46340\n'),
    (['good'], '-2147483648\n'),
    (['good'], '0\n'),
    (['bad'], '10\n'),
    (['bad'], '50000\n'),
    (['bad'], '-2147483648\n'),
    (['all'], '10\n20\n'),
    (['foobar'], '10\n20\n'),
]

all_match = True
for args, stdin_data in test_cases:
    p1 = subprocess.run(['./chal'] + args, input=stdin_data, text=True, capture_output=True)
    p2 = subprocess.run(['./recon_bin'] + args, input=stdin_data, text=True, capture_output=True)
    if p1.stdout != p2.stdout or p1.stderr != p2.stderr or p1.returncode != p2.returncode:
        print(f'MISMATCH for args={args}, stdin={stdin_data!r}')
        print(f'chal: out={p1.stdout!r}, ret={p1.returncode}')
        print(f'recon: out={p2.stdout!r}, ret={p2.returncode}')
        all_match = False

if all_match:
    print('ALL TEST CASES MATCHED PERFECTLY!')
"
